statement.document_title: o3, AGI, the art of the demo, and what you can expect in 2025

our_interpretation: The relevant population is distinct AI influencers and company speakers claiming during 2025 that AGI had already been reached.
Almost nobody means definitions would be exceptional among those claimants, not merely absent from a majority.
A definition is an explicit description of the capabilities or threshold the claimant means by AGI. It need not be persuasive or universally accepted.
Count definitions in the declaration, its linked explanation, or a subsequent public explanation during 2025.
The antecedent is the existence of qualifying 2025 AGI claimants; it does not require first proving that there were a lot of them.
criteria.support_condition: A representative collection of qualifying claimants and their explanations shows that only exceptional cases supplied an explicit definition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Such a collection shows that a substantial share supplied definitions, beyond isolated exceptions.
